title: Facade – SFS, Closures, Gutters & Balconies (PER)
activity: SFS, VCL, Siderise, membranes, gutters, balconies, balustrades, veils and soffits
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: SFS (Stanta) plumb, on setting-out and fully fixed?
VCL taped with the correct tapes, joints sealed?
Rockwool and breather membrane complete, no gaps?
Siderise fire/acoustic closures continuous and tight at slab edges?
Obex membrane applied at heads, sills and junctions, lapped as drawn?
Surespan walls and insulation in before the gutter?
Gutter fixed and falling to outlets, outlets clear?
Sealant joints primed and tooled (SikaHyflex 250), membranes by others lapped in?
Balcony centred in the bay, level, pressings aligned with finished floor?
Balcony fixings torqued with threadlocker; balcony-to-precast joint sealed?
Membrane by others in at the balcony step (5 cm fold)?
Balustrade glass plumb and secured, kite mark bottom-left from inside, handrail joint mid-glass?
Finishing profiles fixed, joints sealed, no damage to glass or handrail?
Veils adjusted in tolerance, Obex separator on the lower bracket?
Veil joints sealed (Dowsil 791), every shingle screwed, clips sealed?
Soffit panels engaged and locked, square to grid, undamaged?
